headline: Chipmakers slide after Nvidia's big rally
context: Investors sold chip and AI hardware stocks a day after Nvidia's huge rebound, but most other shares rose and the Dow gained.

winners.name: Dollar Tree
winners.why: Quarterly profit beat forecasts at $1.16 a share vs $0.91 expected, as more shoppers came in. It raised its full-year forecast.

winners.name: CoStar Group
winners.why: No company news. Fellow property services firm CBRE also rose, as real estate stocks gained.

winners.name: Moderna
winners.why: No company news. Biotech stocks rallied together, with Amgen, Biogen and Regeneron also rising.

losers.name: Analog Devices
losers.why: Results beat forecasts, but it plans to more than double its investment spending next year, and chipmakers fell broadly.

losers.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
losers.why: Results beat forecasts, but it warned profit margins on AI servers will shrink and parts could stay scarce into 2028.

losers.name: Dell Technologies
losers.why: Fell with HPE on worries about AI server profits, ahead of its own results, which came out after the close.

sector_note: Median move of stocks in each S&P 500 sector
chart_title: Tech fell, every other sector rose

watch.title: Inflation and GDP data
watch.text: PCE, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, plus a revised Q3 growth figure.

watch.title: Thanksgiving break
watch.text: US markets are shut on Thursday and close early, at 1pm, on Friday.

question: Was Monday's chip rally too much, too fast?
